text: Figure 4.18: the debounce timer debounceTimer is an increasing timer. It is local to the ExecutableEntity execution-instance . The activation counter activations is a local integer to count the pending activations. The runnable de- bounce timer and the activation counter are like the whole state machine just concepts for the specification of the behavior, not for the implementation.
